Public Engineering Log • Signed Universal x64 & Native ARM64

Version History & Release Notes

Follow every milestone of RaggieSoft Installer Studio as it evolves in public as original, zero-dependency native Win32 C++20 software.

Download Latest v0.5.0 (Auto-Detects CPU) Full Offline Installer (x64 + ARM64 in One EXE) Inspect v0.5.0 Screenshots Read FAQ
Latest Release • November 2026

v0.5.0 — 10 Selectable Wizard Styles (Incl. 1995 ACME #008080 Teal & #000080 Cobalt Washes), Classic & Custom Setup Types, Billboards & WCAG Auto-Contrast

  • 10 Selectable First-Party Wizard Styles ([UI] WizardLayout): Shipped standard (RaggieSoft Glass), wizard95 (classic #C0C0C0 3D beveled sheet + 164px left graphic rail + etched 3D push buttons), wizard97 (enterprise top-banner sheet), aerowizard (command-bar header), fluentmica (Windows 11 DWMSBT_TABBEDWINDOW surface + 7-stage vertical step rail), oneclick (compact express splash with Customize... expansion), passivetoast (/passive & /qb progress banner), fullscreenblue (1995 #000080 → #000000 Cobalt-Blue wash), fullscreenteal (1995 #008080 Microsoft ACME Setup Engine Teal callback), and autorun16x9—all yielding automatically to SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST Windows Contrast Themes.
  • Classic Windows 95 & Author-Defined Setup Types (SetupTypePreset & [SetupType.*]) + [Billboard.*]: Added 4-card win95_classic Setup Types (Typical, Compact, Complete, Custom mapping cleanly to INSTALLLEVEL=100, 20, 1000, and SelectionTree), custom repeatable [SetupType.<Id>] cards with explicit ADDLOCAL feature lists, and floating 3D [Billboard.<Id>] feature showcase cards + docked 3D sunken progress gauges on full-screen retro backdrops.
  • Live WCAG 2.2 AA Brand Contrast Enforcer (RswWcagContrast.hpp & RSW055): Added W3C relative luminance validation in instbuild.exe --validate (RSW055) plus a live contrast badge and one-click Auto-Fix WCAG button in InstallerStudio.exe that snaps custom brand hex colors into dual-theme accessibility (≥ 4.5:1 vs. #FFFFFF button text and ≥ 3.0:1 vs. #15203A Dark Mode cards) while preserving publisher hue.
Milestone • November 2026

v0.4.5 — Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing (Public Trust Authenticode), ARM64 /dlib SignTool Dispatch & Pre-Signed Template Safety

  • 100% Cryptographically Signed Release via Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing: Every inner suite executable (InstallerStudio.exe, instbuild.exe, SetupWizard.exe, msiprism.exe, RaggieSoftHelp.exe), both inner x64 & ARM64 .msi databases, and all four outer installers (-setup.exe Smart Web Stub, -offline-setup.exe Universal Offline EXE, -x64-setup.exe, and -arm64-setup.exe) are Dual-Layer Authenticode-signed with verified Public Trust identity and RFC 3161 SHA-256 timestamps (http://timestamp.acs.microsoft.com).
  • Architecture-Aware /dlib SignTool Dispatch on Windows 11 ARM64: Upgraded LocateWindowsSdkSignTool in instbuild.exe to inspect the PE IMAGE_FILE_HEADER::Machine of external Azure.CodeSigning.Dlib.dll plugins and automatically invoke the matching x64\signtool.exe or arm64\signtool.exe—eliminating 0x800700C1 (ERROR_BAD_EXE_FORMAT) in-process DLL load failures on ARM64 developer workstations.
  • Clean Pre-Signed Bootstrapper Resource Stamping (StripExistingPeCertificates): Added ImageEnumerateCertificates / ImageRemoveCertificate (imagehlp.dll) cleanup prior to BeginUpdateResourceW so pre-signed SetupWizard.exe templates never leave dangling IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_SECURITY offsets when stamping customer Setup.exe resources, alongside headless CI/CD RSW_SIGN_* environment-variable overrides.
Milestone • November 2026

v0.4.4 — Plain-English Feature Inclusion Tiers Replacing Raw InstallLevel Jargon & Public FAQ

  • Plain-English Included In Feature Tiers (minimal, typical, complete, hidden): Replaced cryptic numeric Windows Installer InstallLevel textboxes across InstallerStudio.exe (Features and Components & KeyPaths views) and .rsip manifests with human-friendly setup tiers—compiling cleanly down to standard MSI Feature.Level + INSTALLLEVEL SQL thresholds (1, 50, 150, and 0) while keeping 100% compatibility with explicit numeric overrides.
  • Smart Compact / Typical / Complete Runtime Tiering: Upgraded Minimal / Compact setup in SetupWizard.exe to INSTALLLEVEL=20 alongside Typical / Express (INSTALLLEVEL=100) and Custom SelectionTree defaults—laying the direct foundation for customizable Windows 95-style Setup Types (Typical, Compact, Complete, Custom, & [SetupType.*]) in v0.5.0.
  • New Public /faq Page: Added comprehensive Frequently Asked Questions covering code signing, why 32-bit x86 and IA-64 Itanium host OS builds are skipped (and how x64;1033 / Arm64;1033 avoids the Intel64;1033 trap), and how 64-bit instbuild.exe will still package legacy 32-bit VB6 apps.
Milestone • November 2026

v0.4.3 — CPU-Aware Smart Web Stub & Combined Offline Universal Single-EXE (x64 + ARM64)

  • Smart CPU-Aware Web Stub (<Product>-setup.exe): Everyday users never have to guess whether their Windows 11 PC has an AMD64 (x64) or ARM64 processor. Compiled as a zero-dependency static /MT 64-bit x64 launcher that starts natively on Intel/AMD PCs and via Prism on Windows 11 ARM64 PCs, it calls IsWow64Process2 in under 0.1ms to detect true native silicon, streams only the matching native installer over HTTPS (WinHTTP) inside an accessible Dark/Light/High-Contrast progress dialog, verifies its build-stamped SHA-256 digest (bcrypt.dll), and launches the genuine native installer.
  • All-in-One Offline Universal EXE (<Product>-offline-setup.exe): Bundles both LZMS-compressed x64 and ARM64 native installers inside a single self-contained portable executable for air-gapped workstations, USB drives, and archival preservation—automatically extracting and executing the host's true native architecture while forwarding all CLI flags (/s, /qn, --extract-msi, INSTALLDIR=...).
  • Visual IDE, CLI & Standing Screenshot Automation: Added BuildUniversal and UniversalDownloadBaseUrl controls to InstallerStudio.exe, --universal to instbuild.exe, strict x64;1033 / Arm64;1033 PID_TEMPLATE verification in insttests.exe, and export-all-screenshots.ps1 so 100% of website screenshots are freshly captured on every release.
Milestone • November 2026

v0.4.2 — 12-View Tree-First Visual IDE, Features & RegEdit Registry Trees, Categorized MSI Prism & Inspector Fixes

  • 32-Bit ARGB Vector Tree Engine (StudioTreeIcon + ApplyDarkTreeViewTheme): Replaced flat LISTBOX and SysListView32 overuse across InstallerStudio.exe, msiprism.exe, and RaggieSoftHelp.exe with 20 anti-aliased premultiplied ARGB vector icons and Windows 11 DarkMode_Explorer / Explorer chevrons.
  • Categorized 12-View Sidebar & New Dedicated Features View: Grouped IDE navigation under Application Information, Setup Architecture, User Interface, and Deployment & Source, and added a dedicated All Features hierarchy view with Move Up / Move Down AST reordering, + New Feature, + Sub-Feature, DisallowAbsent core locks, and live Feature Description editing.
  • New RegEdit-Style Registry View + .REG File Importer: Added nested hive/subkey folder navigation across HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT, HKEY_CURRENT_USER, HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, HKEY_USERS (HKU), and HKEY_USER_MACHINE_DEFAULT (HKMU) paired with a typed right-hand values tree, per-Feature filtering, and UTF-8 / UTF-16LE .reg script importing.
  • Dual-Tree Files & Folders, Shortcuts Tree, Live Component Inspector & Categorized msiprism.exe: Upgraded Destination Contents, Application Runtimes & .MSM, File Associations, and Shortcuts (Start Menu & Desktop) to hierarchical trees, wired live TVN_SELCHANGEDW Component inspection in Components & KeyPaths, and organized msiprism.exe SQL tables into 5 logical schema categories.
Milestone • November 2026

v0.4.1 — Dark-Mode Push Buttons & Live OS Theme Hot-Swapping

  • Dark-Mode-Aware Accessible Push Buttons (AttachAccessiblePushButtonSubclass): Replaced stock ComCtl32 v6 light-mode white push buttons across SetupWizard.exe (< Back, Next >, Cancel), InstallerStudio.exe, msiprism.exe, and RaggieSoftHelp.exe with 100% public-API SetWindowSubclass + GDI+ vector buttons while keeping native UI Automation Button roles and Alt+Key mnemonics intact.
  • Live WM_SETTINGCHANGE(ImmersiveColorSet) Palette Hot-Swapping: All four Win32 GUI binaries listen for live Windows 11 Light ↔ Dark Mode and Contrast Theme broadcasts, flipping DWM frames, cards, buttons, checkboxes, headers, dropdowns, and RichEdit typography in < 16ms without restarting.
Milestone • November 2026

v0.4.0 — Native C++20 Help System, Dark-Mode UI Subclasses & AI Blueprints

  • New RaggieSoftHelp.exe Native C++20 Help Viewer: Converted RaggieSoft's modular .rshm.json documentation viewer into a 100% static /MT Win32 C++20 binary (zero .NET and zero WebView2 dependencies!) featuring Contents, Index, full-text Search, in-process HTML5-to-RTF typography (Msftedit.dll), and single-instance Named Pipe F1 IPC.
  • Bundled raggiesoft.installer-studio Offline Help Module: Shipped 8 comprehensive offline HTML5 chapters wired directly to F1 across the IDE and mirrored 1:1 to /docs.
  • Global Win32 Dark Mode Checkbox & ListView Header Subclasses: Added AttachAccessibleCheckboxSubclass and AttachDarkAwareListViewSubclass in RswGlassRenderer.hpp so checkboxes and SysListView32 column headers maintain ≥ 15.8:1 WCAG AAA contrast across Dark, Light, and High Contrast modes.
  • Expanded From-Scratch AI Agent Blueprints & Screenshot Exporter: Upgraded instbuild.exe --emit-ai-spec (/llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /SKILL.md) and added --export-screenshots across GUI tools.
Milestone • November 2026

v0.3.0 — Editions Parity, LZMS Compression, Pre-MSI Runtimes, .MSM & SelectionTree

  • IDE Editions (Community == Premier): Defined Community, Express, Professional, and Premier tiers with Community permanently maintaining 100% feature parity with Premier.
  • Windows LZMS Solid Compression: Integrated COMPRESS_ALGORITHM_LZMS (Cabinet.lib) to shrink embedded Product.msi and offline runtime payloads inside Setup.exe.
  • Unlimited Pre-MSI [Prerequisite.*] Runtime Broker & 64-Bit .MSM Merger: Added curated and custom runtime execution before msiexec under one UAC prompt plus native 64-bit SQL + CAB Merge Module consumption.
  • Authentic Windows Installer SelectionTree & Clean Status Formatting: Added 32-bit ARGB split-dropdown feature icons, live byte-cost cards, DisallowAbsent core locks, and MsiFormatRecordW status formatting.
Bugfix & Polish • November 2026

v0.2.1 — Real-World Setup Fixes, Dark Mode Checkboxes & UAC Elevation Broker

  • Added Dark Mode checkbox subclassing in SetupWizard.exe, bottom-right footer navigation, persistent Signature / AppSearch locator SQL tables, and seamless asInvoker → --elevated-msi-worker UAC elevation.
Feature Milestone • November 2026

v0.2.0 — Destination Computer Tree, Component Rules & Dual Dialog Designers

  • Added the Destination Computer folder tree, Microsoft Component Rule validation (ICE18, ICE38, ICE64, ICE80), File Associations & Shell Verbs, guided Win32 AeroWizards, and the 370×270 MSI.DLL SQL Dialog Designer.
Initial Preview • November 2026

v0.1.0 — Zero-Dependency Win32 C++20 Toolchain Foundation

  • Initial x64 + ARM64 static /MT release of instbuild.exe, SetupWizard.exe, InstallerStudio.exe, msiprism.exe, and insttests.exe with deterministic SHA-1 UUIDv5 GUIDs, RtlGetVersion + IsWow64Process2 detection, .rsip/.rsis/.rsii lossless AST, --emit-ai-spec, and --emit-vpat.
